key_highlights: ASX suffers sharp $169B weekly rout amid rising recession risks and domestic economic strain.
Unemployment hits a five-year high, prompting market calls that the RBA tightening cycle is over.
Severe housing downturn accelerates across major capitals, depressing household borrowing capacity.
Department store distress deepens with David Jones cutting 1,700 jobs as Myer targets market share.
AUD faces strong depreciation pressure, driving capital toward safe-haven gold and critical minerals.

sectors.trend: Asset quality risks rising alongside accelerating home price falls and higher unemployment; governance issues under scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Expect margin compression, muted loan growth, and rising provisioning for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Active equity capital markets supporting gold exploration and rare earth breakthroughs despite broader equity liquidation.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors and critical mineral developers offer defensive tactical opportunities, buffered by weaker AUD revenue conversion.

sectors.trend: Aggressive restructuring and workforce cuts at legacy retailers facing consumer pullback and online migration.
sectors.implications: Headwinds across discretionary retail, though Myer (MYR.AX) stands to capture supplier and footfall share from David Jones.

sectors.trend: Steepening property price declines and depressed borrowing capacity weighing on property valuations.
sectors.implications: Asset write-downs and cautious capital management required for residential-exposed developers and REITs (SGP.AX, MGR.AX).

sectors.trend: Domestic gas supply tensions and infrastructure project scrutiny amid geopolitical shipping flashpoints.
sectors.implications: Near-term cash flows remain firm for domestic gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX), though domestic regulatory scrutiny persists.

sectors.trend: AI-driven corporate workforce restructuring contrasting with strong venture interest in generative AI platforms.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) faces valuation multiple compression from macro headwinds despite automation productivity gains.

sectors.trend: Defensive positioning supported by resilient balance sheets and GLP-1 drug disruption altering consumer food habits.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX and specialty pharma provide macro defensive buffers; supermarkets (WOW.AX, COL.AX) face evolving basket dynamics.

key_themes: Macroeconomic deterioration as five-year high unemployment raises domestic recession probabilities.
Terminal rate reached as RBA faces pressure from cracking labor and housing markets.
Sharp $169B valuation reset across the ASX 200, prompting defensive rotation.
Currency weakness creating headwinds for importers while hedging USD-denominated commodity producers.
Bifurcated retail sector where traditional discretionary models face existential restructuring.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of cyclical and consumer discretionary equities into high-quality defensive and cash assets.
Underweight major residential mortgage lenders and direct residential developers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD Depreciation and Imported Cost Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize global offshore earners and USD-hedged resource producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Governance and Regulatory Scrutiny in Banking
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor risk-weighted assets and operational risk provisioning within major banking holdings (NAB.AX).

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Critical Minerals Producers
opportunities.rationale: Resilient pricing, AUD currency depreciation benefits, and strong capital raise backing offer macro downside protection.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to Department Store Consolidators
opportunities.rationale: Myer stands to capture market share, suppliers, and customer volume amidst David Jones store rationalization.

opportunities.recommendation: Core Long Position in Offshore Healthcare Earners
opportunities.rationale: CSL offers inelastic global demand and FX tailwinds from AUD weakness, isolating earnings from domestic recession risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Domestic Mortgage Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Surging unemployment and accelerated housing price declines increase non-performing loan risks and curtail credit expansion.
Broad market liquidity flush following $169B weekly drop signals elevated risk of further index-level capitulation.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Allocation to Residential REITs and Consumer Discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: High borrowing costs and falling net wealth continue to suppress household discretionary spending and property transactions.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months; the ASX 200 remains vulnerable to further valuation de-rating as labor market weakness and housing contraction weigh on corporate earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral to cautiously constructive over 6–12 months; market stabilization expected once RBA acknowledges economic slack and commences monetary easing cycle.

CoreLogic capital city residential property index prints
Australian Bureau of Statistics labor force and wage price updates
China macroeconomic data releases impacting iron ore and bulk commodity exports
Corporate half-year earnings and impairment provisioning announcements

Major bank 90+ day mortgage delinquency rates
Auction clearance rates across Sydney and Melbourne
ASX 200 benchmark support levels following the $169B drawdown
